title.narrative: Preparatory Study: Youth Engagement in Gagauzia

description.narrative: Silba Ambassadors for Dialogue and Youth of Gagauzia (YoG) in Moldova wish to explore a future potential partnership. The two groups met during the DUF Moldova Explore mission in April 2024, and again during a Partner Identification conducted in August 2024. This time, the two project groups will dive into a concrete project idea on conducting a youth leadership training for youth from across different regions in Moldova. This project will both build on experience with prior leadership trainings carried out by Youth of Gagauzia, and dialogue seminars carried out by the Ambassadors for Dialogue group in their current partnership with Egyptian partners Ambassadors for Dialogue, with whom a DUF pilot project is currently also taking place.
